name: Sero
soft_passes: #1 mask discipline — fits the squircle cleanly but bakes the drop shadow, top-rim highlight, and mask into the raster (HIG: ship square unmasked layers)
#4 16px squint — glyph survives, but the ~10% ring stroke thins to ~1.6px and the near-black container edge is defined only by the baked shadow (bloom rescues legibility)
#5 single light model — predominantly emissive (ring lights the void) but a faint top-rim highlight implies a second top-down environment light
#9 era coherence — hybrid: Big-Sur front-facing squircle container + custom dark-emissive treatment + Liquid-Glass-adjacent iridescent tint, no single system era

#10 variant robustness — passes (carrying ring glyph survives mono/tinted), but the bloom+iridescence drama is contingent on the black ground and it ships as a baked raster, not layered Default/Dark/Clear/Tinted

palette.background: flat near-black cool: #161616 (edges) -> #14283C (center navy vignette), squircle corners alpha 0

light_model: Emissive / self-luminous: the ring is the light source, blooming outward into a near-black ground; faint baked top-rim environment highlight on the squircle edge; radial vignette darkens the aperture center. No top-down scene light.
layer_stack: baked squircle mask + baked drop shadow
radial center vignette (inside the ring's eye)
devices: emissive aperture — glyph as its own light source, blooming into the black
conic electric-blue -> lavender iridescent sweep on the ring (Liquid-Glass specular tint on flat art)
radial center vignette giving the flat ring lens/void depth
baked Big-Sur squircle + soft drop shadow + faint top rim (raster-baked container hygiene)
rhymes_hint: Dark luminous-emblem icons — a single geometric glyph rendered as its own light source on near-black (AI/utility register: Raycast/Arc/terminal-dark neighbourhood). Palette family: electric-blue -> lavender iridescence. Direct corpus cousin: alcove (both dark-ground glowing focal, cool iridescent ramp, raster-baked) — but Sero is stronger: it has a carrying silhouette and a subject-linked glyph where alcove leans wholly on its gradient field.
notes: Native 1024x1024 master, no gradient banding — but PRE-MASKED: corner alpha 0 plus a baked drop shadow and faint top-rim highlight, i.e. a fixed raster render, not square unmasked Icon Composer layers, so variant behaviour is inferred not observed. Ring is optically centred (~512,520, 8px low = correct nudge), outer diameter ~684px (~67% canvas, round-glyph fill), stroke ~100px (~10%). The ring reads simultaneously as the O of 'Sero', the zero of 'zero resistance', and a search lens/aperture — honest subject-mining. Glyph could be read as a letter/digit O but is a geometric ring, not set type, so #12 passes. Brand coherence is strong: the icon's #189FFC->#E1D1FF ring ramp is the same blue->lavender axis as the cover's gradient sky.
